headline: Core-market growth is slowing while two adjacent segments are accelerating

bullets.text: Core-market growth has fallen from 22% to 9% over two years
sub: The market is maturing; the Company already holds the leading share

bullets.text: Two adjacent segments are growing faster than the core market
sub: Both are underserved by the Company's current product

bullets.text: The FY27 growth target requires a second engine beyond the core market

annotation: The question is not whether to expand, but which segment and how fast.
source: Illustrative data — replace with your own metrics.
